name: OpenCode Quota
author: caopengfei
description: 紧凑面板显示 OpenCode Go 订阅剩余额度：滚动 5 小时、每周、每月三档，带进度条与重置倒计时。只读，仅访问一个接口；中英双语，默认跟随系统语言。
safetyNotes: 只读。唯一请求是 GET opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage，且仅在当前供应商为 OpenCode Go 时发出；换成其他供应商时不显示任何数字、也不发请求。manifest 已把出网范围限制为 opencode.ai。不读取对话记录、项目文件，也不读取 PI-Desktop 自身的供应商密钥；API Key 保存在本机插件设置文件中，不会发往任何其他地方。
changelog:
0.3.1 — 上架信息改为中文。
0.3.0 — 首个公开版本：滚动 5 小时 / 每周 / 每月三档额度、进度条与重置倒计时；中英双语，默认跟随系统语言。

settings.title: OpenCode Go API 密钥 / API Key
settings.description: 在 opencode.ai/console 的「账户 → 个人 API 密钥」创建。保存在本机插件设置文件中。

en.name: OpenCode Quota
en.description: OpenCode Go subscription quota in a compact panel: rolling 5-hour, weekly and monthly allowance left, with reset times. Read-only, one endpoint, English and Simplified Chinese.
en.safetyNotes: Read-only. It calls exactly one endpoint (GET opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage) with an OpenCode Go API key that you paste into this plugin's settings, and only while the active provider is an OpenCode Go one — with any other provider the panel shows no numbers and makes no request. It never reads chats, transcripts, project files, or PI-Desktop's own provider secrets; the key stays in this plugin's local settings file on your machine and is sent nowhere else.
